snippet.title: Danganronpa: Gods at Gunpoint Prologue (Demo)
snippet.description:
Trigger warning for blood and violence! Also excessive swearing! 
Howdy everyone! Sorry for the wait on this walkthrough, I've been pretty busy with midterms, but here's the video for the demo of my fanganronpa, Gods at Gunpoint! It's a demo by All definitions, having a lot of placeholder backgrounds and of course placeholder music for the time being, but here it is! In the future, I plan on re-releasing it as a Fully Polished Prologue along with when I end up releasing the first chapter of the game. 
Anyways! The link to play it yourself is here -https://deimosatellite.itch.io/gods-at-gunpoint
And you can follow along with development at the instagram, 
https://instagram.com/godsatgunpoint !
also support my main instagram loool! 
https://www.instagram.com/deimosatellite/
Thanks to everyone for yall's support so far! Now that I've polled to have each chapter released individually, I'm guessing it won't be too long until the first chapter will be released. For the time being, I'm mostly working on writing the entire script overall, and then once that it does I'll focus my entire attention on developing the first chapter along with the trial, which I hope to be able to implement minigames! Hopefully. Also to any of yall curious, this was made fully in ren'py! I'd highly recommend it for anyone who wants to make a visual novel/game!

Thanks yall for stopping by and stay tuned for the next parts! 

disclaimer: i dont own the placeholder music used! It's all written by the lovely Masafumi Takada, and from the canon Danganronpa games!
